title: Audit Stream Orchestrator TF Module for VPC Deployments
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create a reusable Terraform module (audit-stream-orchestrator) to standardize audit log routing for Redwood Private/VPC deployments. The module will provision CloudTrail sinks, encrypted S3 buckets for raw event archive, Kinesis Data Firehose (or managed delivery) to an OpenSearch ingest cluster in the customer VPC, and configurable ILM/lifecycle policies for both OpenSearch indices and S3 archives. Goals: (1) make secure audit streaming easy to install for new customers, (2) provide safe upgrade paths for existing installations, (3) include healthchecks and smoke-tests to ensure logs are flowing and retention rules are enforced, (4) keep operator controls for retention/archival to comply with customer requirements. Key requirements: param-driven KMS CMK ARN, option for cross-account CloudTrail, toggle between direct OpenSearch delivery vs Firehose->S3->Ingest lambda, fine-grained retention windows (raw archive days, searchable index hot/warm/cold phases), automated ILM policy templates, secure defaults (SSE-KMS, block public access, bucket locking options). Module must be compatible with Redwood Private's upgrade lifecycle and be publishable to our internal Terraform registry with semver tags. Deliverables: TF module code, examples (single-account and cross-account), automated acceptance tests (terratest or kitchen-terraform), module docs/usage guide, migration scripts for customers using older audit modules, and PRs for ops playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: TF module provisions CloudTrail sinks pointing to a Kinesis Firehose with encryption using supplied KMS CMK
Delivery options: direct OpenSearch delivery (private endpoint) OR Firehose->S3 with lambda-based ingest are both supported and selectable via variable
S3 bucket encryption, public access block, and lifecycle rules (move to GLACIER after configurable days) are configurable and enforced
OpenSearch ILM templates are applied automatically for indices created by the module and documented defaults are provided
Healthcheck terraform-test runs verify recent CloudTrail events are indexed in OpenSearch within target latency (<= 5 minutes) or are present in S3 archive
Module published to internal registry with examples and changelog; upgrade notes included for any breaking changes
Security review sign-off obtained and all resources support customer-managed KMS keys
